concerns.text: The power analysis (Phase 4) converts the target R² ≥ 0.6 to Cohen’s f² and uses `statsmodels.stats.power.FTestPower`, which assumes a linear regression framework. The downstream model is a Random Forest regressor, a non‑linear, ensemble method whose effect‑size behavior does not map directly to the linear‑model f² definition. This mismatch may render the sample‑size justification invalid for the chosen algorithm.
